artworks.title: Title Page for "Le Sourire" (Titre du Sourire)
artworks.description: The image features curving and jagged lines forming distinct shapes such as a person wrapped in cloth, a bull, and a bird. To the left, the text "Les Souitine" is intertwined with swirls, while on the right, faces with mask-like features are visible. The design shows bold contrast between light and shadow, resembling a carved or scratched appearance of woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Nave Nave Fenua (Delightful Land)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure in full view, facing slightly sideways with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has long dark hair falling over their shoulders and a flower in their hair, standing among plants and foliage. The figure is holding a stem with heart-shaped leaves, and the background features abstract wave-like patterns and a border with geometric shapes and carvings on the left. At the top, there is text saying "NAVENAVE FENUA."

artworks.title: Noa Noa (Fragrant, Fragrant)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting stylized, symbolic figures and abstract elements. The central figure has a large hat and is surrounded by natural elements and abstract shapes. A second figure wearing a dress is near water with ripple patterns. Intricate designs above include human portrayals and the words "NOA NOA" in a cloud-like area. This artwork combines human and natural forms with abstract art elements in the style of Paul Gauguin.

artworks.title: Manao Tupapau (She is Haunted by a Spirit)
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in a curled position, with their head resting on their forearms and knees drawn up towards their chest. Their facial features are minimalistic, with simple lines. The person has short, closely cropped hair and is wearing form-fitting clothing. In the background, there are abstract patterns and another figure sitting upright, with dark and light contrasting sections. Engraved text and patterns are also present in the background.

artworks.title: Te Po (The Long Night)
artworks.description: The image features fluid, swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition. At the top left is a circular shape with radiating lines. Below is a figure enveloped by flowing lines resembling a river. To the right are three standing figures. A small circular shape emitting wispy lines is at the bottom right. The word "TE PO" is inscribed near the bottom left.

artworks.title: L'Univers est crée (The Creation of the Universe)
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and curving shapes creating an abstract composition with dynamic movement. In the center, a seated figure is surrounded by other humanoid forms blending into the textures. To the right, an oversized, fish-like creature with a prominent eye and fin appears, dominating the space. Smaller figures below engage with elemental forms, and the lower portion features a smooth, elongated shape resembling a flowing river or ribbon.

artworks.title: Maruru (Thank You)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract landscape scene with figures. The composition features stylized figures and natural elements, depicted in a way that draws inspiration from symbolic and indigenous art. The foreground includes abstract figures in different positions surrounded by elements representing vegetation and mountains. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and white, highlighting texture and contrast created by lines and patterns. The scene conveys a harmonious narrative, showcasing a cultural depiction or a mythological tale.

artworks.title: Mahna no Varua Ino (The Devil Speaks)
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and curved shapes creating an abstract scene. On the left, figures resembling seated people are depicted with rounded shapes suggesting heads and limbs. On the right, there are dynamic lines and shapes suggesting a blazing element, with figures that could be seen as interacting with it.

artworks.title: Cup
artworks.description: The image shows a large goblet with intricate scrollwork and ornamental details. It is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black. The goblet is centrally positioned, featuring elaborate floral and geometric designs across its surface, as well as detailed decoration on the stem and base.

artworks.title: Cup
artworks.description: The image shows a decorative object with intricate designs and reliefs. The color palette is grayscale, featuring shades of black, white, and gray. The object is centrally positioned, standing upright with detailed patterns, floral motifs, and sculpted faces along the stem and base.

artworks.title: Jar with Neptune
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate jug or ewer with intricate designs and figures. It is primarily in black and white, suggesting it is an etching or engraving. The jug's body is central, with a handle extending to the left and a spout to the right. The spout is decorated with various figures, including a humanoid figure and a dragon or sea creature.

artworks.title: Woman and Child (Weib und Kind)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with three full-body figures. The central figure has one arm raised and the other hanging by their side. They have distinct facial features, including strong eyebrows, a pronounced nose, and short dark hair. To the left, a smaller figure with a forward-leaning stance and similar hair is depicted. To the right, a third figure with partially turned back is shown, obscuring facial details. None of the figures are wearing clothing, and visible sketch lines add depth to muscles and contours. The background is plain with cross-hatched lines for texture, and no accessories are present.

artworks.title: Macbeth V (The Vision of Lady Macbeth)
artworks.description: The image depicts intricate swirling lines converging around a central figure, surrounded by other humanoid shapes. Some shapes resemble ethereal figures or spiritual apparitions. In the lower portion, there is a silhouette resembling a reclining human form. The abstract composition invites contemplation of the relationships between the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a man standing. He is slightly turned to the side, looking at a book he holds open in one hand. The man has a nose, a beard, and curly hair. He wears a long robe and fabric footwear, with a halo around his head. The background is neutral and the setting appears to be indoors with a textured tiled surface.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a composed expression. They have a beard, short hair, and are dressed in robes. The person holds a sword in their right hand and an open book in their left hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man standing. He is turned slightly to his right, with his head facing forward and eyes looking into the distance. The man has deep set eyes, a long beard, and curly hair that surrounds a bald spot on the top of his head. He is wearing a long, draped robe that covers most of his body, with intricate folds suggesting a heavy and layered fabric. In his left hand, he holds a book with a patterned cover, clutched close to his chest. In his right hand, he holds a large sword, with its tip resting on the ground. Behind his head is a round halo. The background of the image is plain, highlighting the central figure without distraction. The floor is illustrated with a pattern.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image portrays a person standing upright, facing forward with curly hair falling to their shoulders. They wear a long, flowing garment that covers their body from neck to feet. A halo-like circle surrounds their head. The person holds a chalice in their left hand, while making a gesture with their right hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Street Vendor Selling Spectacles at the Door
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10.2 × 8.6 cm (4 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is an artwork of a rustic outdoor scene with an exchange taking place. The drawing shows a doorway with one individual inside leaning on the door frame and another individual outside wearing a broad-brimmed hat and cloak, holding a tray. In front of the doorway, there is a child-like figure with their back turned, holding a basket on the ground. The setting includes a wooden structure with woven fencing and surrounding trees. The pen work displays detailed cross-hatching for depth and texture. The scene suggests a marketplace or social interaction in a village or rural setting, reminiscent of the Dutch Golden Age style focusing on domestic scenes.

artworks.title: Christ Consoling the Centurion
artworks.description: Multiple figures are shown in a circular image, some with upper bodies and others up to their knees. In the center stands a figure with a narrow, bearded face, long hair, and a halo of radiating lines. They wear a loose garment. A figure kneels before them, wearing a robe and holding a staff. To the right are three additional figures in robes. One has a beard, like the central figure. Lush foliage is depicted at the top right, with a distant settlement on the left. The scene is enclosed within a circular border, displaying skillful shading techniques.

artworks.title: Christ with Three of His Apostles
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures gathered beneath an apparition in the clouds. The circular sketch features a central group of figures in flowing robes gesturing and conversing. The setting includes trees, rocks, a small village with houses, and mountainous terrain in the background. Above them in the sky, a figure in the clouds with raised hands is depicted. The style employs fine linework and hatching to create depth and texture, with detailed attention to clothing and the ethereal presence in the sky.

artworks.title: Christ Stilling the Storm
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boat surrounded by waves. It is a detailed black and white circular image, showing a small boat navigating choppy waters. The boat has a spotted texture, and figures inside appear to be engaging in various activities. One figure is holding an oar. The figures are intricately drawn, adding to the dynamic feeling of the scene. The sky above shows swirling clouds, suggesting turbulent weather. In the background, faint outlines of buildings or coastal landscape can be seen, adding depth to the image. Shadow and linework create a sense of movement within the waves and among the figures.

artworks.title: Jan Asselijn
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man seated with his left arm resting on a table. He has a long face, elongated nose and lips, and long, curly hair falling to his shoulders. The man wears a wide-brimmed hat, and his clothing includes a collar and puffy sleeves. Books and papers are stacked on the table beside him. The background consists of blank walls.

artworks.title: Woman with the Arrow
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper

artworks.title: Jan Antonides van der Linden
artworks.description: This etching shows a man from the waist up positioned slightly facing the left. He has a calm expression, a prominent nose, fine eyebrows, short styled hair, and wears a dark garment with a white collar and cuffs. He holds an object in his right hand. The background has diagonal hatched lines and an architectural feature to his left, partially obscured by foliage.
